summary: Quote and booking types expose quote_type, source_package_id, package_snapshot, and booking_origin.
The existing quote route is a thin export to QuoteDetailScreen; editor family and operation derive from loaded booking, quote, and authorized business role, not the changeOrder URL hint.
Fixed package scope is read-only; only validated positive add-on drafts reach send_fixed_addons. Fixed package approval uses approve_fixed_change_order and retains its approval-time addon obligation.
Generic itemized send/approve/approve-with-coins/reject RPCs fail closed for marketplace fixed, proposal, and time-based bookings, while inspect and explicit BYO itemized routes remain supported.
Owner/manager quote actions are visible; staff/customer editor access is rejected. Managed travel lines and the strict parts-over-500-paise proof requirement remain guarded.
implementation.featureOffBehavior: No new Oorva or acquisition feature gate was added. Existing approval, payment, refund, settlement, and cleanup paths remain ungated.

sqlCoverage: Fixed package copy, version, base immutability, and post-approval addon obligation.
Owner/manager send, staff/customer denial, stale-link closure, and unsupported marketplace family RPC atomicity.
Inspect positive coin delta and reduced-total refund; explicit BYO itemized revision and generic coin approval.
tests.validationGate: Do not run app, Jest, SQL, or parser selectors until the coordinator returns the shared-registration roundtrip SHA for this exact SQL test and allocated migration parser.

validation.gitDiffCheck: PASS before follow-up review fixes; rerun before checkpoint commit

iteration1.finding: A second fixed add-on could supersede an approved_pending_payment package change order and lose its pending scope/obligation.
iteration1.status: FIXED: server guard before writes; editor hides pending state; SQL regression added.
